output.reason: Reported one-month difficulty falling asleep with work stress and daytime tiredness while still functioning, with no reported red-flag feature, can be addressed with sleep-habit guidance now and a clear action-based escalation trigger rather than a clinician task today.
output.patientMessage: Start sleep-habit changes now: keep the same bed and wake times daily, avoid caffeine in the afternoon and evening, keep the bedroom cool, dark and screen-free, and if you're awake about 20 minutes, get up and do something calm. Stress-related trouble falling asleep often eases with this. Message a Counsel clinician here if low mood or hopelessness develops, you doze off while driving, or sleep doesn't improve with these steps.
